finding: ClayGraph current-head projections and incremental EAP dependency maintenance materially reduce hot-path traversal/rebuild cost while preserving the rule that graph state is rebuildable derived topology, not semantic truth. Tombstone retention and same-logical/same-epoch ambiguity gates remain mandatory.
negative_evidence: Deleting non-CURRENT heads allowed out-of-order resurrection and was rejected.
Same-logical/same-epoch multi-version ambiguity prevents verified single-head projection without an explicit tie contract.
Graph activation cannot satisfy proof/authority merely by score or reachability.
counterhypotheses: A conventional adjacency/materialized-view scheme may provide similar speed with less graph-specific machinery.
Real noisy/stale graph structure may reduce the measured synthetic/equivalent-mechanism gains.
ancestry_policy: V3 heads, EAP incremental topology and their benchmark/test descendants are one coordinated implementation lineage, not independent replications.
